title: TikTok: The real hourly wage of a young investment banker

lines.text: This twenty-two-year-old earns over a hundred thousand dollars a year. But per hour, he makes less than you think.
He is a first-year investment banker in New York.
His job: helping giant companies buy each other, or go public on the stock market.
His base salary is over one hundred thousand dollars. With bonus, it can reach around two hundred thousand.
Sounds like a dream. But in a survey from twenty twenty-one, junior bankers at Goldman Sachs said they worked ninety-eight hours a week.
Going to bed around three in the morning. Sleeping about five hours a night.
Now divide that base salary by ninety-eight hours a week. That is about twenty-two dollars an hour.
In that same survey, only about half expected to still be at the bank six months later.
So why does anyone still want this job? Because the few who make it to the top can earn around a million dollars a year.
Would you trade your twenties for that? Tell me in the comments.
